title: PillCheck
subtitle: What the official labels say about the medicines you take together. English, Tamil, Hindi.
closing: Code decides. The model explains. A person decides the dose.

scenes.title: Two medicines, one warning
scenes.caption: Code finds the pair in the FDA label and quotes it; the model explains it plainly.
scenes.input: I take warfarin for my heart. Can I also take Ecosprin that my neighbour gave me?
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "I take warfarin for my heart. Can I also take Ecosprin that my neighbour gave me?"

scenes.title: Asked in Tamil
scenes.caption: Amazon Translate in, the same checks, Amazon Translate out.
scenes.input: நான் warfarin எடுத்துக்கொள்கிறேன். தலைவலிக்கு Combiflam சாப்பிடலாமா?
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "நான் warfarin எடுத்துக்கொள்கிறேன். தலைவலிக்கு Combiflam சாப்பிடலாமா?"

scenes.title: A medicine it cannot check
scenes.caption: No official label, no guess.
scenes.input: Is Zorvitan okay with my metformin?
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "Is Zorvitan okay with my metformin?"

scenes.title: A dose question in Hindi
scenes.caption: A hook cancels every model call; a fixed reply sends them to a pharmacist.
scenes.input: क्या मैं Glycomet की खुराक दोगुनी कर सकता हूँ?
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "क्या मैं Glycomet की खुराक दोगुनी कर सकता हूँ?"
